reasoning: No English translation of the Orthographiae ratio has ever been published. WorldCat records 30 Latin editions (1561-1607) with no English-language edition. Archive.org, HathiTrust, ABAA, Britannica, Wikipedia, I Tatti Renaissance Library, and rare-book dealers all confirm Latin-only publication. The 2016 ISBN 9789333319522 is a Latin facsimile reprint, not a translation. This specialized Renaissance Latin philological treatise (a guide to Latin spelling conventions) has no known English version.
